通过提示引导控制和自然混合实现照片级真实脸部替换

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

FLUX Kontext Face Swap 通过自动对齐、精细控制和本地化再生，帮助创意人员实现准确、自然的面部替换。

重要节点：

Comfyui FLUX Kontext Face Swap 工作流程中的关键节点

自动裁剪脸部（＃119 和＃122）

检测人脸并生成用于对齐和粘贴的裁剪元数据。如果脸部部分缺失或包含您不想要的头发，请稍微增加裁剪尺寸或降低检测置信度以获取更多背景信息。

脸部对齐（＃121）

在合并之前使用 InsightFace 地标将源面扭曲到基础面几何体上。切换分析设备脸部分析模型（＃120）到图形处理器当可用于更快的对齐时。

图像粘贴脸（＃125）

使用裁剪数据将对齐的脸部混合到基础图像中。如果边缘看起来很锐利或颜色不均匀，请尝试使用稍大的裁剪框或减少任何提示后的攻击性，以便 FLUX 在边界周围减少过度绘制。

FluxKontextImageScale（＃134）

将复合材料重新缩放为 Kontext 期望的原始形状，以便 VAE 可以在不失真的情况下进行编码。将其保留在适当的位置以防止精炼输出中的拉伸或漂移。

UNET加载器（＃140）

加载经过 Kontext 调整的 FLUX UNet。将此与 LoRA 一起使用以实现预期行为FLUX Kontext 脸部交换。更改检查点将显着改变皮肤纹理和整体保真度。

LoraLoader仅模型(#141)

适用把它放在这里 LoRA进行局部重建。如果交换漂移或编辑溢出到表面之外，请稍微增加 LoRA 影响。如果感觉外观被锁定，请减少它以获得更多的创作自由。

双CLIP加载器(#8) 和CLIP文本编码(#6)

提供文本调节。提示应简短并针对面部区域和表情。如果您想保留基本图像背景和服装，请避免使用全局样式提示。

通量指导(#5)

平衡采样器对参考组合的信任程度。提高它可以更紧密地保留基本构图，降低它可以在面部区域内进行更强的提示驱动编辑。

注释

FLUX Kontext 换脸 | ComfyUI 工作流程— 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

o.en:
Photoreal face replacement with prompt-guided control and natural blending

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

FLUX Kontext Face Swap empowers creatives with accurate, natural face replacement using automatic alignment, refined control, and localized regeneration.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui FLUX Kontext Face Swap workflow

AutoCropFaces(#119 and #122)

Detects faces and produces crop metadata for alignment and pasting. If the face is partially missed or includes hair you do not want, increase crop size slightly or lower detection confidence to pick up more context.

FaceAlign(#121)

Uses InsightFace landmarks to warp the source face onto the base face geometry before merging. Switch the analysis device inFaceAnalysisModels(#120) toGPUwhen available for faster alignment.

Image Paste Face(#125)

Blends the aligned face into the base image using the crop data. If edges look sharp or color is off, try a slightly larger crop box or reduce any post-prompt aggressiveness so FLUX does less overpainting around the border.

FluxKontextImageScale(#134)

Rescales the composite to the native shape expected by Kontext so the VAE can encode without distortion. Leave this in place to prevent stretching or drift in the refined output.

UNETLoader(#140)

Loads the Kontext-tuned FLUX UNet. Use this together with the LoRA for the intended behavior ofFLUX Kontext Face Swap. Changing the checkpoint will noticeably alter skin texture and overall fidelity.

LoraLoaderModelOnly(#141)

AppliesPut it here LoRAto localize reconstruction. If the swap drifts or edits spill outside the face, increase the LoRA influence slightly. If the look feels locked, reduce it for more creative freedom.

DualCLIPLoader(#8) andCLIPTextEncode(#6)

Provide text conditioning. Keep prompts short and targeted to the face region and expression. Avoid global style cues if you want to preserve the base image background and clothing.

FluxGuidance(#5)

Balances how much the sampler trusts the reference composite. Raise it to preserve the base composition more tightly, lower it for stronger prompt-driven edits within the face area.
